common_rules:
Repo: the run folder (suggested C:/Developer/PeasyPrints-kada19), branch kada-19/demo-site, cut from kada-18/implement-redesign. Swoop: Next 16 app router, React, Tailwind, Clerk, Firebase client + Admin SDK, Razorpay. Edit only the files listed for your package. Never commit, push or edit a ledger (the lead does).
Goal: a demo of Swoop on sample data, fully browsable including sign-in, run locally by `npm run demo` at http://localhost:3019 with NO env.
Contract (src/lib/demo/mode.ts and contract.ts, built by SWITCH; import them, never redefine):
- isDemoMode() = NEXT_PUBLIC_SWOOP_DEMO==='1' && NODE_ENV!=='production'. Demo implies fixture mode. Production can never be in demo, and every /api/demo/* route returns 404 unless isDemoMode().
- Cookies: swoop_demo_visitor (visitor id, minted by the proxy), swoop_demo_session (client-readable base64url JSON {uid, emails?:[{address, verified, google}]}; no cookie = signed out), swoop_demo_date ('nov'|'may'|'july'; none = nov).
- Personas: sana = verified-kju-main (KJU Main, default), kabir = verified-kju-airport, ananya = girls-approved, meera = pending-id-card. New-student walk-through: uid new-user (Riya) with riya@kju.test (college, Google) or riya.t@gmail.test (personal). KJU's demo email domain is kju.test.
- Demo API: /api/demo/session (POST {persona} | {google:'college'|'personal'} | {emailCode:{email}}; PATCH {addEmail}; DELETE), /api/demo/session/card, /api/demo/firestore, /api/demo/state, /api/demo/reset, /api/demo/date, /api/demo/razorpay/pay, /api/demo/orders/[id]/collect.
- Stand-ins: in the demo dev build only, webpack aliases swap @clerk/nextjs, @clerk/nextjs/server, @clerk/nextjs/errors, firebase/app, firebase/auth, firebase/firestore, firebase/storage and razorpay for src/lib/demo/shims/clerk-client.tsx, clerk-server.ts, clerk-errors.ts, firebase-app.ts, firebase-auth.ts, firebase-firestore.ts, firebase-storage.ts, razorpay-server.ts. An alias is live once its shim file exists. Shims export every name the repo imports, never touch window at import, and throw 'Not in the demo: <name>' for anything outside the demo.
- World: in demo, getAdminDb() and getAdminBucket() return the visitor's own seeded fake world. Seasonal pack doc ids start with 'season-'.
Rules: pick demo code at module level (const useX = isDemoMode() ? useDemoX : useRealX), never a conditional hook call; with demo off, behaviour is unchanged. No live services: never call Clerk, Firebase, Razorpay, PostHog or any host but localhost. Next 16 is not the Next you know: read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before using routing, params, searchParams, cookies(), proxy or config APIs (params, searchParams and cookies() are async). Pure modules that node tests import: '@/...' only as `import type`, runtime imports relative with the .ts extension, no enums or parameter properties. Tests live at tests/<dir>/<name>.test.ts with node:test and node:assert/strict.
Design: Swoop design system v1 (src/components/swoop primitives, icons, illustrations). Dense. Sentence case, never the `uppercase` class. Plain English, each line under 10 words. Prices via formatPrice, never the rupee sign. The mocked Google step is a plain Swoop sheet with a Demo chip, never a copy of Google's page. Demo copy says plainly that it is sample data.
Never build: events, gigs, jobs, food surfaces, pets.
Done means: npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm test pass. UI: check on http://localhost:3019 (npm run demo) at 375 and 1280 px, no horizontal scroll, no console errors, network only localhost. End with a self-review of at most 8 lines: what you built, files, checks and results, anything skipped.

packages.brief: Today src/lib/firebase/admin.ts keeps one seeded FakeFirestore and FakeBucket on globalThis for everyone. In demo, give each visitor their own. world.ts: getWorld(id) makes {id, bootId, db, bucket, rev, changes}, seeded with seedFakeDb(db, now) on first use; dropWorld(id); changesSince(rev); currentWorldId() reads swoop_demo_visitor via `await cookies()` (missing, or outside a request: 'default', warn once). FakeFirestore and FakeBucket take an optional async store resolver, so every async operation (doc get/set/update/delete, add, query get, transaction, batch commit, file save/download/delete) runs on the visitor's world; tests and plain fixture mode keep the single store. Serialize transactions per world. Each write bumps rev and logs the path, except _rate_limits, payment_idempotency and ids starting 'season-'. On world access call tickOrders(world, nowMs) and tickLife(world, nowMs) (throttle 2 s); on creation call applySeason(world, dateId from swoop_demo_date).
